TEXT:
[FI] ...And after that, our lives were filled with dizzying 
days.
[FI] Where would be a good place to start, I wonder?

[FI] Due to Kyousuke's and Nee-san's persuasions, my 
parents attended our wedding despite us being on 
bad terms.

[FI] My father-in-law and mother-in-law called out to us 
with congratulations.

[FI] Former classmates and coworkers came, livening 
up the wedding reception.

[FI] We went to Guam for our honeymoon and the two 
of us enjoyed ourselves with all that we had.

[FI] Since we've gotten married, I've been bad at 
cooking like always. Even now I trouble Manami-san 
about it.
[FI] And...
[FI] We had a daughter.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Mummy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] What is it, Kanami?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hair, tie it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] How would you like it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Meruru!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, yes.

[FI] They're currently airing the remake of the anime 
that I cosplayed a long time ago.

[FI] I find it nostalgic every time I see it and I recalled 
my old dream.

[FI] I wonder if I show my daughter photos from that 
time, what kind of face will she make?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Mummy, you were Meruru before, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] *cough* *cough*

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Who told you that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Bridget-chan.

[FI] On the television my daughter pointed towards, a 
familiar golden-haired and blue-eyed girl appeared.
[FI] She's grown up to be quite beautiful- Bridget.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...That rascal.

[FI] The popular idol Bridget, who was very active in 
Japan, graduated from being an idol and is now an 
actress.
[FI] She mainly acts in Japanese films.

[FI] When I look upon the scene of my former dream, 
my eyes were dazzled.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: [FI] I'm home!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Welcome home! Auntie!

[FI] Upon seeing Kirino arriving, my daughter made a 
huge smiling face.
[FI] Kanami really loves her gentle and sweet aunt.

[FI] Kirino's been working overseas and had come back 
to Japan for a few years... Currently, she's staying 
together with us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Don't call me "Auntie"~. I'm still only in my 20s~

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yup! Got it! Auntie!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ergh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] A-Ah, right! I have a special guest for today!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Tadah!

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: [FI] Good afternoon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Welcome, Bridget.

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: [FI] Mhm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] But, she's not much of a special guest, is she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Didn't she come by just recently?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Eh? It's been three days, hasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...It's fine though, since it's fun.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Right? Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: [FI] ...Ahahaha, I'm indebted to you every week.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Auntie! Buy this! It's Meruru's!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] What what!? I'll buy you anything you want~! Ah, 
this? If it's this, then I already have it! It's the latest 
thing, right? I'll bring it to you now!
[FI] Kirino noisily dashed out of the living room.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm home- whoa!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ouch! Hey, watch where you're going, old man!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Shut up, you NEET. At your age and still living with 
family!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] That's for me to decide. This is my home, after all!

[FI] From outside the living room, I could hear that 
quarrel.

SPEAKER: SPK_BRIDGET
TEXT: [FI] Sounds like your husband's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah... sorry about the ruckus.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I'm home.

[FI] Together with the voice that I waited eagerly for 
every day, my husband returned from working on 
a day off.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm glad I was able to come back during the day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Daddy!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, sorry about that, it's Sunday but I had to 
work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Let's watch Meruru together?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sure, all of us!

[FI] This spectacle, just how many miraculous events 
did it take to establish this?

[FI] I think about that every time I remember how our 
romance started.

[FI] I think about that every time I remember how the 
two of us made it here, despite a rough and 
dramatic journey.
[FI] There were people who gave us their blessings.
[FI] There were people who didn't.

[FI] ...And there were people who, after many months 
and years passed, finally gave us their blessings.

[FI] And there were people who pursued the dream I 
gave up on.
[FI] And finally.

[FI] From now and forever, I will be with the people I 
love.
[FI] From now on, no matter what troubles arise.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Welcome home, dear.
[FI] I am very happy.
